name: Chest 1/2
how_to_measure: Lay flat, measure straight across 2.5 cm below the armhole.

name: Waist 1/2 (top)
how_to_measure: Measure straight across at the narrowest point of the body.

name: Bottom hem 1/2
how_to_measure: Measure straight across the bottom edge, hem relaxed.

name: Body length from HPS
how_to_measure: From the high point of the shoulder straight down to the hem.

name: Centre back length
how_to_measure: From the centre back neck seam down to the hem.

name: Across shoulder
how_to_measure: From shoulder point to shoulder point along the back.

name: Shoulder drop
how_to_measure: Vertical distance from HPS level down to the shoulder point.

name: Across front
how_to_measure: Straight across the front 12 cm below HPS, armhole seam to armhole seam.

name: Across back
how_to_measure: Straight across the back 12 cm below HPS, armhole seam to armhole seam.

name: Armhole straight
how_to_measure: From the shoulder point straight down to the underarm point.

name: Sleeve length from shoulder
how_to_measure: From the shoulder point along the top fold to the sleeve opening.

name: Sleeve length from CB
how_to_measure: From centre back neck over the shoulder point to the cuff edge.

name: Bicep 1/2
how_to_measure: Straight across the sleeve 2.5 cm below the underarm.

name: Elbow 1/2
how_to_measure: Straight across the sleeve at half the underarm length.

name: Sleeve opening 1/2
how_to_measure: Straight across the sleeve edge, relaxed.

name: Cuff height
how_to_measure: From the cuff seam to the cuff edge.

name: Neck width seam to seam
how_to_measure: Straight across from neck seam to neck seam at HPS.

name: Front neck drop
how_to_measure: From an imaginary line between HPS points down to the front neck seam.

name: Back neck drop
how_to_measure: From an imaginary line between HPS points down to the back neck seam.

name: Collar / rib height
how_to_measure: From the neck seam to the finished edge at centre back.

name: Placket length
how_to_measure: From the neck seam to the placket bottom along the placket.

name: Hem height
how_to_measure: From the finished edge to the hem stitch line.

name: Waist 1/2 (bottom)
how_to_measure: Button closed, measure straight across the top of the waistband.

name: Hip 1/2
how_to_measure: Straight across 18 cm below the waistband top edge.

name: Front rise
how_to_measure: From the crotch seam to the top of the waistband at the front.

name: Back rise
how_to_measure: From the crotch seam to the top of the waistband at the back.

name: Thigh 1/2
how_to_measure: Straight across the leg 2.5 cm below the crotch.

name: Knee 1/2
how_to_measure: Straight across the leg at half the inseam.

name: Leg opening 1/2
how_to_measure: Straight across the leg at the hem.

name: Inseam
how_to_measure: From the crotch seam along the inside leg to the hem.

name: Outseam
how_to_measure: From the top of the waistband along the side seam to the hem.

name: Waistband height
how_to_measure: From the waistband seam to its top edge.

name: Fly length
how_to_measure: From the waistband seam to the bottom of the fly stitch.
